Moon.consequence: Traction, wheel sinkage and regolith dynamics change completely.
No wind erosion or convection; dust charges up and sticks electrostatically.
Direct exposure to solar wind and cosmic rays.
Extreme thermal cycling; permanently shadowed craters drop below -230 °C.
Long shadows and extreme contrast that Earth terrain cannot reproduce.

Mars.consequence: Wheel sinkage and the angle of repose of loose material change.
Wind drag and the saltation threshold are not comparable.
Cosmic rays and solar particles reach the surface.
Thermal fatigue of materials and batteries.
Absolute height is not comparable, so it is left out of the index.
